comparison.objective: Draw a self-retracting lifeline below lock speed and hook it to a harness D-ring, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Speed-regulated tether extraction, hook alignment, and latching against retraction versus small-tool engagement, fine adjustment, tightening, and impact-cycle observation.
comparison.success_condition: Lifeline extended without triggering its lock and hook secured versus two non-bottoming stops and drift-resistant adjustment.
comparison.reason: Both concern velocity-sensitive equipment, but tether handling/latching does not tune or validate an impact absorber. Body/spec thresholds, including lock speed, are missing.
